---
title: API key
description: Create, use and revoke a WriteStack API key for MCP clients that don't support OAuth.
---

Use an API key when your MCP client can't do OAuth. Every request sends it as a bearer token:

```http
Authorization: Bearer ws_...
```

Keys start with `ws_`. A key acts as your WriteStack account, so treat it like a password.

## Create a key

1. Open **Settings → AI assistants (MCP)** in WriteStack.
2. Under **API Keys** (below "Or use an API key for agents without OAuth"), click **Generate Key**.
3. Give it a name (optional) so you know which client uses it, and click **Generate**.
4. Copy the key from **API Key Created**. You can also copy a ready-made MCP configuration JSON from the same dialog.

The full key is shown only once. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.

## Revoke a key

In **Settings → AI assistants (MCP)**, click the trash icon next to the key and confirm with **Revoke Key**. Clients using it stop working right away.

## Errors

| Message | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `Unauthorized: invalid API key.` | The key is wrong, revoked, or missing the `Bearer ` prefix. |
| `MCP access is not available on your current plan…` | The key is valid, but your plan doesn't include MCP. See [plans and limits](/docs/account/plans-and-limits). |

Prefer [OAuth](/docs/build/connect/oauth) when the client supports it: nothing to copy, and access can be revoked per client.
